verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for SaaS accounting software, so the axis applies. The pack documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec and per-resource read endpoints such as contacts, but these are developer building blocks for building an extraction yourself. Nothing in the pack shows a first-party export of all data in open formats (CSV, XML/XBRL, full-account archive) or an account-exit flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
